Here is a comprehensive list of all environment variables required by the `orbital-invoices` service, categorized by their purpose, along with an explanation of what each one controls.

The variables are sourced from `.env`, `.env.example`, and are validated in `src/config.js`.

### Core Application Settings

| Variable Name | Required? | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `NODE_ENV` | Yes | Sets the application environment (`development`, `staging`, `production`). Used to determine operational mode. |
| `PORT` | Yes | Specifies the port number the Express server will listen on (default is 8080). |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | Yes | Controls the verbosity of logging (e.g., `debug`, `info`, `warn`). |
| `APP_BASE_URL` | Yes | The base URL for the application, likely used for generating links or callbacks. |
| `INVOICE_PDF_TIMEOUT_MS` | Yes | A timeout value (in milliseconds) specifically for PDF generation processes. |
| `FEATURE_DUNNING_V2` | Yes | A feature flag (boolean string) to enable or disable the V2 version of the dunning logic. |

### Database & Caching

| Variable Name | Required? | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `DATABASE_URL` | Yes | The full connection string for the PostgreSQL database. This includes credentials, host, port, and database name. |
| `DATABASE_POOL_MAX` | Yes | Sets the maximum number of active connections the application can maintain with the PostgreSQL database pool. |
| `REDIS_URL` | Yes | The connection string for the Redis cache service. |

### Payment Processing (Stripe)

| Variable Name | Required? | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | Yes | The secret API key required to interact with the Stripe API for creating charges. |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Yes | The secret key used to verify incoming webhook events from Stripe, ensuring data integrity. |
| `STRIPE_PRICE_ID_PRO` | Yes | The Stripe Price ID associated with the "Pro" tier, used when creating charges. |

### Authentication & Security

| Variable Name | Required? | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Yes | The secret key used for signing and verifying JSON Web Tokens (JWTs). |
| `SESSION_SECRET` | Yes | The secret key used for signing and encrypting session data. |
| `ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD` | Yes | A password used for initial administrative setup or bootstrapping processes. |
| `TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` | Yes | Defines the Time-To-Live (TTL) for access tokens, specified in seconds. |
